quote: Never store authorization-relevant state client-side unsigned (e.g. `is_admin=1` cookie); signed cookies must also be encrypted if contents are sensitive, and validated server-side per request.
note: Section '## 7. Cookies'; the sentence is not cookie-only ('client-side', e.g. a cookie). The token carries role and expiry, i.e. authorization-relevant state held by the client, so it must be signed and validated server-side.
